description.text: Ten single attacks (0.71 each), grants [50% Damage Reduction Barrier 1] to all allies, grants [Attach Earth with Stacking], [Quick Cast 1] and [Second Rebellion] to the user

description.name: 50% Damage Reduction Barrier 1
description.text: Reduces damage taken by 50% for the next attack

description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Second Rebellion
description.text: Grants [Quick Cast 1] to the user after using an Earth ability
